title: draba rupestris var. gracilis
intro: Draba rupestris var. gracilis, commonly known as Alpine Draba, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a type of wild mustard that grows in mountainous regions, typically found in the Alps. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Draba rupestris var. gracilis include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial and anticancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
